name: Holland
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Holland?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Holland, a registered low-speed vehicle may use streets posted 35 mph or less and may cross a faster street. No city resolution allowing plain golf carts was found.

rules.rule: A registered low-speed vehicle may use a street posted 35 mph or less, and may cross a faster street.
A city may allow golf carts only by resolution. No Traverse City or Holland resolution was found.
I-196 is above the 35 mph cap

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Holland?
faq.a: Streets posted 35 mph or less. Not on I-196. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Holland?
faq.a: No. Michigan allows that only after the city adopts a resolution, and none was found.

faq.q: What streets can an LSV use in Holland?
faq.a: Streets posted 35 mph or less. A faster street can be crossed, not driven along.
